<h1>Botanicals</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Botanical illustrations in colour, cut out of their paper: red alstroemeria, crimson flax, two tulips, spotted and star orchids, and a scroll painting of peaches. Long side up to 1000px, PNG only: a trace would flatten the washes and hatching.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>Colour and life on gathering and magazine pages; one plant per section.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>As painted.
